}}{{TIDTOC|adapter}} ==Overview== *The second generation [[Roku HD]] is a Netflix/Pandora/MLB TV streaming device with :built-in b/g WiFi according to Roku, but the FCC photos show a b/g/n capable chipset. *They may just be the wrong photos though since they are identical to the photos for the [[Roku XD]]. :Unlike the previous generation of Roku devices, the second generation [[Roku HD]] now holds the wireless :components on the main board along with two U.FL connectors in addition to two onboard antennas.
===FCC Info=== *[[Roku HD (2000C)]] :CPU: [[NXP]] PNX­8935 @400MHz (Nexperia Semi / Trident MS) :WLAN: [[Broadcom]] BCM43231KFBG (2T2R 802.11bgn 300Mbps) :RAM: 4x [[Samsung]] K4H51083 (4x 64MB) 256MB (SDRAM DDR) :Flash: [[Samsung]] K9F1208UDC-PCB0 64MB (NAND TSOP-48)
